checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same mountains, trees, clouds, lake in original positions
must.why: Layout and shapes match the source.

must.item: Reflections and surface details retain structure
must.why: Reflection structure preserved, though shadows are crushed.

must.item: No sun, sunset, extra clouds or elements added
must.why: The whole image now reads as a golden sunset with a glowing yellow sky; no literal sun, but the look goes well beyond a colour tweak.

must.item: Framing, geometry and detail unchanged apart from colour
must.why: Geometry is the same, but contrast and darkness increased heavily, losing detail in the trees and shadows and changing the mood.

faults.what: Over-the-top warm grade: the sky is saturated yellow-orange and the original soft pastel tones are lost; it is more than just warmer.
Contrast and darkness increased: forests and shoreline are crushed to near-black, so tree detail is lost; this is not a colour-only change.
Posterized, harsh look with banding in the sky.

summary: The composition is preserved, but the result is an extreme golden-sunset grade with crushed shadows and lost detail, not a subtle warming that leaves everything else unchanged.
